verdict.rationale: Netlify documents an official Netlify SDK, but its stated scope is building extensions and custom integrations rather than general-purpose client SDKs for the platform. A code snippet (`getStore(...)`) suggests a first-party storage library, and a REST API is documented, but no OpenAPI spec was found and no language client SDKs are evidenced. Missing for 10: documented official client SDKs for the REST API across languages, SDK reference depth, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Build extensions and custom integrations with the Netlify SDK to enhance workflows, add UI components, and connect third-party services.
